# Tiers — hours and types

<!-- Generated by tools/content_strategy/build.py from content-types.toml. Do not edit by hand. -->

Registry version 1.0, updated 2026-11-15. Minutes are the owner's own time per
piece (review, record, post, reply). They are estimates until the Monday log has a quarter of actuals.

## Hours a week

| Tier | Estimated | Cap | Pieces a month | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Starter** | 2.2 h | 3 h | 11 | The promises and one habit. Nothing else. |
| **Core** | 4.6 h | 5 h | 18 | Adds the weekly clip reaction, video on the monthly, the question series, dated milestones and a second reply session. |
| **Full** | 7.4 h | 8 h | 26 | Adds the eToro long form every two weeks, the video episodes, a third reply session, every earnings check and four event campaigns. |

## Types by tier

| Layer | Type | Slot | Starter | Core | Full | Min each |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Promise | **Monthly report** | First trading day of the month, for the month just closed | monthly | monthly | monthly | 120–150 |
| Promise | **Report video** | Within 48 hours of the monthly report | — | monthly | monthly | 90 |
| Promise | **Mid-month update** | The 15th. Writing only | monthly | monthly | monthly | 60–75 |
| Promise | **Quarterly review** | First week of January, April, July and October, after that month's report | — | quarterly | quarterly | 180 |
| Promise | **Annual letter** | January, for the year just closed | — | — | yearly | 300 |
| Series | **Weekly Quote** | Tuesday morning | weekly | weekly | weekly | 20 |
| Series | **Evergreen Question** | Thursday, in the weeks of the monthly report and the mid-month update | — | 2 a month | 2 a month | 40 |
| Series | **Holding Anniversary** | On the date a position turns 1, 2, 3, 5, 7 or 10 years | — | monthly | monthly | 30 |
| Series | **Clip reaction** | Friday, or the day the clip airs. A short clip from a broadcast, credited, with your take | — | weekly | weekly | 40 |
| Series | **X video episode** | Thursday, in the weeks between the reports. Vertical, three minutes at most | — | — | 2 a month | 150 |
| Series | **eToro long form** | Monday, in the weeks between the reports. About 400 words, from the week's data pages | — | — | every 2 weeks | 45 |
| Reactive | **Breaking + my take** | Within 48 hours of news that touches a holding or a standing theme | weekly | 2 a month | weekly | 30 |
| Reactive | **Earnings check** | After a top holding reports, never before. Within five trading days | — | monthly | 20 a year | 30 |
| Reactive | **Practitioner note** | On demand, for a company you use at work but do not hold. Say in the post that you do not own it | — | — | 6 a year | 45 |
| Campaign | **Event campaign** | Around an event: at least three picture posts on X and one short video, then a recap | — | 2 a year | quarterly | 240 |
| Habit | **Reply session** | Monday, Wednesday, Friday. Thirty minutes under larger accounts, then post an original | weekly | 2 a week | 3 a week | 30 |
| Evergreen | **Profile and pins** | Refreshed in the first week of each quarter | quarterly | quarterly | quarterly | 30 |
| Ops | **Monday metrics log** | Monday | weekly | weekly | weekly | 10 |
| Ops | **Monthly audit** | First week of the month | monthly | monthly | monthly | 15–30 |

## Pillar mix, by pieces a month

| Tier | Educational | Performance | Engagement | Promotional |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| *Default target* | 40% | 30% | 20% | 10% |
| Starter | 78% | 19% | 0% | 3% |
| Core | 58% | 29% | 12% | 2% |
| Full | 58% | 32% | 9% | 1% |

Reply sessions are engagement work but not pieces, so they are not in this table. The promotional
share stays near zero while the copy invite is gated (see the strategy, *Open decisions*).
